the detection of threat items in X-ray images of baggage can be increased by a factor of two or more, and this increase is obtained by a factor of three or more in the time spent to screen the images.

(1) human factors technology is a key component in aviation security and (2) it is possible to significantly increase the efficiency of human operators by applying the results of research on visual cognition, object perception and psychophysics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new technologies to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of the X-ray screening of baggage.
increasing efficiency in airport security screening by optimizing the design of the operator’s task environment and the training of the operator to perform his or her task.
the following questions: How do people detect objects in X-ray images?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of human factors technologies can significantly increase threat detection and thus the efficiency of aviation security.
the human factors approach to aviation security screening has the potential to increase threat detection substantially, while at the same time reducing the workload of the operator.
the human operator is not a weak link in aviation security but that the human factors technologies currently in use are not up to the task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human operator is not a passive recipient of images.
the human factors approach is an effective and efficient way to improve security performance in X-ray screening of baggage.
the efficiency of X-ray screening can be increased by a factor of three by using human factors technologies that improve the performance of human operators and reduce the workload on them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the human factors component in aviation security is at least as important as the technology component.
the human factors component of aviation security is not a cost but a profit center.
the human operator is not only the weakest link in airport security but also the strongest link in airport security.
